answer: Give each agent one lantern-lit identity: lock 220 POA for 150 days on one hardware key. Every 12 days, three random staked peers send a live task due in 90 minutes; the reply must quote that hour's public Dover Strait ship count from the live AIS feed. Miss once: burn 70 POA plus a 50-day freeze. Miss twice: full 220 POA slash plus a 140-day ban. Forging 1,000 identities costs 220,000 POA, 1,000 keys at $40 each, and 3,000 live tasks every 12 days. Real reputation is the nectar honest agents gather; a sybil swarm is only an echo, loud in the dark, holding no lantern.
